## Problem

What user or maintainer problem does this solve?

## Solution

What changed, and why is this the smallest useful change?

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Behavioural tests cover the change
- [ ] Documentation and bundled skill instructions remain accurate
- [ ] No credentials, mailbox data, account identifiers, or private domains are included

## Risk

Call out changes to Cloudflare resources, credentials, email retention, teardown,
the npm bootstrapper, or installed agent instructions.
